info.title: Podorozhnyky+ API
info.description: Travel Stories API, endpoint-for-endpoint compatible with the original project (v1, /api/*), plus the v2 extensions (/api/v2/*): facets, natural-language search, map, anonymous saves, booking, travel links.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users sorted by articlesAmount descending. `_id` is used as a stable tie-breaker. This allows the Home page to request `page=1&limit=4` for the agreed top-4 travellers.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Values below 1 are invalid.

200.description: Successfully found users. A page beyond the end returns 200 with an empty users array and hasNextPage=false.

patch.description: Partially updates the authenticated user. Only name, email and description are accepted. Email is normalized with trim + lowercase. Email verification is outside the current MVP.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased before validation and uniqueness check.

description.description: Trimmed. Empty string is allowed to clear the profile description.

400.description: Invalid request data or unknown field

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user avatar. Allowed MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp. SVG/GIF, empty, corrupted, or MIME/content-mismatched files are rejected. Maximum size is 512000 bytes (500 KiB); exactly 512000 bytes is allowed.

avatar.description: JPEG, PNG or WEBP image, maximum 512000 bytes.

400.description: No file, unsupported type, corrupted file or file larger than 512000 bytes

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile including the list of saved story IDs in `favorites`. The `favorites` field can be used by the frontend to determine whether a story is already saved by the current user.

favorites.description: MongoDB ObjectIds of stories saved by the current user.

get.description: Returns public user information and their stories. User stories are ordered by publication date descending with `_id` as a stable tie-breaker. A valid page beyond the result set returns 200 with an empty stories array.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User MongoDB ObjectId. Malformed value returns 400; valid but missing user returns 404.

200.description: Successfully found user profile and stories

message.example: Successfully found traveller profile and stories

get.description: Returns a paginated list of stories with optional category filtering. Stories are sorted by publication date descending with `_id` as a stable tie-breaker. A valid but non-existing category ObjectId returns 200 with an empty stories array.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of stories per API page. Keep the same perPage while traversing consecutive pages to avoid gaps/duplicates.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category MongoDB ObjectId. Malformed value returns 400.

200.description: Successfully found stories. A valid page beyond the end returns 200 with an empty stories array.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or malformed category ObjectId

post.description: Creates a story for the authenticated user. The client sends multipart/form-data with cover, title, article and category. Backend uploads the cover and generates `img`, `ownerId`, `date` and initial `favoriteCount`. Unknown/server-managed fields are rejected.

cover.description: JPEG, PNG or WEBP image. Maximum 2097152 bytes (2 MiB).

title.example: Сванетія: серед веж і гірських легенд

article.example: Подорож до Сванетії залишила незабутні враження...

400.description: Invalid text fields, malformed ObjectId, unsupported/corrupted cover or cover larger than 2 MiB

get.description: Returns stories created by the authenticated user, ordered by publication date descending with `_id` as a stable tie-breaker.

200.description: Successfully found own stories. A page beyond the end returns 200 with an empty stories array.

get.description: Returns stories saved by the authenticated user. The Frontend uses the complete set of saved story IDs as the personal bookmark state and updates/invalidates this cache after favorite add/remove. Results are ordered by story publication date descending with `_id` as a stable tie-breaker.

200.description: Successfully found saved stories. A page beyond the end returns 200 with an empty stories array.

get.description: Returns popular stories ordered by `favoriteCount DESC`, then publication `date DESC`, then `_id` as a stable tie-breaker. This endpoint does not automatically exclude the currently opened story; StoryPage filters its current story client-side and may request one additional item.

200.description: Successfully found popular stories. A page beyond the end returns 200 with an empty stories array.

patch.description: Adds a story to the authenticated user favorites. If the story is already in favorites, returns 400 without creating a duplicate or changing favoriteCount. A user cannot save their own story.

200.description: Story added to favorites. `favoriteCount` increases only when the story is successfully added.

400.description: Malformed story ObjectId or story already in favorites

value.message: Bad request. Story already in favorites

403.description: The owner cannot save their own story

example.message: You cannot save your own story

patch.description: Removes a saved story. If the story is not in favorites, returns 404 without changing favoriteCount. favoriteCount never becomes negative.

200.description: Story removed from favorites. `favoriteCount` decreases only when the story was actually in favorites.

404.description: Story not found or story is not in favorites

get.description: Returns one story. Story contains ownerId; author profile data is obtained separately via `GET /api/users/{ownerId}`.

parameters.name: storyId
parameters.description: Malformed ObjectId returns 400; valid but missing story returns 404.

patch.description: Partially updates a story owned by the authenticated user. Accepts multipart/form-data. If cover is omitted, the existing image remains. `ownerId`, original publication `date` and `favoriteCount` are not client-editable. Unknown/server-managed fields are rejected.

cover.description: JPEG, PNG or WEBP image. Maximum 2097152 bytes (2 MiB).

title.example: Сванетія: серед веж і гірських легенд

article.example: Подорож до Сванетії залишила незабутні враження...

400.description: Invalid request data, unknown field, malformed ObjectId or invalid cover

404.description: Story/category not found, or story does not belong to current user

post.description: Creates a user, creates a cookie session and sets accessToken, refreshToken and sessionId cookies.

name.description: Trimmed before validation. Whitespace-only value is invalid.

email.description: Normalized with trim + lowercase before lookup and uniqueness validation.

password.description: Case-sensitive. Password is not trimmed. No additional uppercase/digit requirement is imposed.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets httpOnly accessToken (15 minutes), refreshToken (1 day) and sessionId (1 day) cookies. Production cookies use Secure and SameSite=None.

409.description: A user with this email is already registered

example.message: Користувач з таким email вже існує

post.description: Authenticates by normalized email and password, creates a new cookie session and sets session cookies.

email.description: Normalized with trim + lowercase before authentication.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets httpOnly accessToken (15 minutes), refreshToken (1 day) and sessionId (1 day) cookies. Production cookies use Secure and SameSite=None.

post.description: Refreshes the cookie session using the refresh session cookies. Refresh session lifetime is 1 day. A successful refresh rotates/updates the session and authentication cookies.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets httpOnly accessToken (15 minutes), refreshToken (1 day) and sessionId (1 day) cookies. Production cookies use Secure and SameSite=None.

401.description: Refresh session is missing, invalid or expired

get.description: Public session-status endpoint. Always returns 200. For a guest `data` is null; for an authenticated session `data` contains the current user.

post.description: Removes the current session and clears accessToken, refreshToken and sessionId cookies.

Set-Cookie.description: Clears accessToken, refreshToken and sessionId cookies.

cookieAuth.name: accessToken
cookieAuth.description: Authentication cookie used by protected endpoints. Auth flows also use httpOnly refreshToken and sessionId cookies. Cookies are Secure and SameSite=None in production.

MongoObjectId.description: MongoDB ObjectId as a 24-character hexadecimal string.

name.description: Trimmed before validation. May contain letters, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens.

avatarUrl.description: Null until the user uploads an avatar.

description.description: Trimmed text. Empty string is allowed to clear the profile description.

article.example: Петра — одне з нових чудес світу...

date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It is not changed by ordinary story editing.

ErrorResponse.description: MVP error contract. Field-error arrays and machine-readable error codes are not part of the current API contract.
